title: Editor E0 foundation: node upgrades preserve authored bags, duplicate placements and stored bench in a pinned corpus
detail: Decomposed from PROG-E0 in the owner-authorized systematic build session 2026-10-08. A bounded gate runs the real upgradeLayout implementation against the SHA-256-pinned 37-document historical structural census (synthetic authored field markers, not tenant values) and an adversarial synthetic fixture. It rejects missing input, changed hashes, orphan fixtures and census truncation; checks deterministic unique node identities, duplicate placements in order, serialized-node idempotence, non-mutation, hidden types, and byte-preserving nonempty authored content/style bags in placed and benched nodes. CI checks includes node-document-safety; 27 focused tests include destructive mutation cases. Does not close PROG-E0: legacy writer dedupe, exact raw-legacy roundtrip, Puck, registry up/down and full D0-D7 remain subsequent children. The seven historical email-template skeletons remain in the archive with their existing deletion explanation.

verify.note: Behavioral plain-Node probe runs the real upgrade and refuses corpus disappearance; no nested test runner.
